verdict.rationale: Candidate self-scheduling is a fair question for an ATS like Lever, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents booking links, live calendar availability, team calendar sync, or timezone handling. The only related mention is "SMS scheduling and rich messaging built-in", which is an adjacent messaging feature and not self-service interview booking.

support.subject: As a recruiter, candidates self-schedule from live calendar availability — booking links tied to my team's calendars end the timezone email chains
